arguments.sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN q.q3 GLOB '[0-9]:[0-5][0-9].[0-9][0-9][0-9]' THEN 'm:ss.sss' ELSE quote(q.q3) END AS time_format,
       COUNT(*) AS qualifying_rows, COUNT(r.raceId) AS matched_races, MIN(d.dob) AS earliest_birth, MIN(q.q3) AS sample_time
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
LEFT JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
WHERE d.nationality = 'British' AND d.dob >= '1981-01-01'
GROUP BY time_format

arguments.sql:
WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name,
           r.name AS race_name,
           r.year AS race_year,
           q.q3 AS q3_time
    FROM qualifying AS q
    JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
    WHERE d.nationality = 'British'
      AND d.dob >= '1981-01-01'
      AND q.q3 <> ''
)
SELECT driver_name, race_name, race_year, q3_time
FROM eligible
WHERE q3_time = (SELECT MIN(q3_time) FROM eligible)
LIMIT -1
